programme.desc: License to Steal. 1961. Stars Stephen McNally, Robert Harland & Harold J. Stone. Investigative reporters Paul Marino & Jack Flood investigate various cases of industrial corruption. (S1, E30)

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Body in the Tunnel. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Matthew Green & Alan Moss. Frederick Gold, a 64 year old coin dealer, fell victim to 22 year old Percy LeFroy Mapleton in June 1881. [S]

programme.title: Sandokan: Pirate of Malaysia
programme.desc: 1964. Action. Director: Umberto Lenzi. Stars Steve Reeves, Jacqueline Sassard & Mimmo Palmara. Sandokan and his team of rebels attempt to stop a British General from forcing the Sultan to resign. [S]

programme.title: Guilty?
programme.desc: 1956. Crime. A Solicitor (John Justin) is convinced that a wartime heroine is innocent of a murder charge but he uncovers more than the evidence he needs. Stars Donald Wolfit & Sydney Tafler. [S]

programme.title: The First of the Few
programme.desc: 1942. War. Directed by and stars Leslie Howard. Features David Niven & Rosamund John. Aviation pioneer R.J. Mitchell struggles to develop the Spitfire fighter plane before war with Germany begins. [S]

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1954. Late Night Final. Director: Montgomery Tully. Stars Colin Tapley, Terence Yorke & Frank Forsyth. An investigation into Joe Burrage unveils a thrilling tale of the man who died twice! (S1, E06)

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Return of Calico Jack. 1957. Stars Brian Worth, Jan Miller & Anne Blake. Calico Jack arrives in the colony while Tempest is away on business, resulting in tension between the two crews. [S]

programme.title: London's Canal Ride in the 1950s
programme.desc: A spectacular look at the sights of London in the 1950s whilst travelling the canals of the great city.

programme.title: Up In The World
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy. Director: John Paddy Carstairs. Stars Norman Wisdom, Maureen Swanson & Jerry Desmonde. A window cleaner works at a country estate where the owner's son is threatened by kidnappers. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Hyde Park Corner
programme.desc: 1959. A look at the changes being made at Hyde Park Corner in London, in particular the construction of a new underpass.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Barge Burglars. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Harry Fowler & Richard Bebb. A gang carries out hold-ups at premises along the Regent's Canal, using a tourist barge to escape, leaving no clues. [S]

programme.title: The Bells Go Down
programme.desc: 1943. Drama. Director: Basil Dearden. Stars Tommy Trinder, James Mason & Philip Friend. A bettor, a bridegroom, and a thief volunteer for the London Auxiliary Fire Service during World War Two. [S]

programme.title: So This Is London 1948
programme.desc: 1948. A wonderful short film looking at London in the past, with a glance at Covent Garden, Tower Bridge, the West End, Buckingham Palace and many more famous landmarks.

programme.title: Give Us A Clue
programme.desc: 1985. The classic game show Give us a Clue hosted by Michael Parkinson, this week's guests are Bella Emberg, William Gaunt, John Inman, Rula Lenska, Anna Quayle & Spike Milligan. [S]

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Sheep Farming/Centenarian Angler. 1981. It's ramming time at the sheep farm, while on the river Frome in Dorset, angler George Dunton attempts to catch a fish on his hundredth birthday. [S]

programme.title: Travelling Man
programme.desc: Blow Up. 1985. Stars Leigh Lawson & Terry Taplin. Lomax is near to finding the man who framed him. A Fleet Street reporter thinks he can help, but the real lead is traced by Lomax's girlfriend. [S]

programme.title: An Englishman Abroad
programme.desc: 1983. Drama. Director: John Schlesinger. Stars Alan Bates, Coral Browne & Charles Gray. Based on a true story, actress Coral Browne has a chance meeting with a member of the Cambridge spy ring. [S]

programme.title: From Here to Eternity
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Fred Zinnemann. Stars Burt Lancaster, Montgomery Clift & Deborah Kerr. A private is punished for refusing to join a boxing team. Meanwhile a torrid love affair is occurring. [S]

programme.title: The Brave Don't Cry
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Directed by Philip Leacock. Starring John Gregson, Meg Buchanan & John Rae. Based on a true story. In a small Scots mining-town, a mine cave-in seals the entire crew. [S]
